subject: Independent reassessment of the Claude audit of M5 authorization 162 ATTEMPT-003

claims_under_review.basis: Replay code regenerates 420 cases and invokes real evaluators in temporary storage.
Fresh execution gates the result, while several reported counts are read indirectly from exact historical documents.
write_outputs is false and immutable M3 blobs remain unchanged.
Five lifecycle states are synthetic fixtures validated against constants from the same module; the PASS is not a real-state check.
CONSUMED_PASS does not read authorization, registry, state, decision, selector, shadow registry or pointer files.
The amendment-3 and corresponding registry approved_by values contain a real double-encoded UTF-8 value.
The encoding defect does not alter the replay result or approval identity, but remains a material documentary regression.
Brief 162 and PEND-LAB-039 retain executable-looking authority after authorization consumption.
Canonical sources fail closed, but stale mandatory-reading artifacts create avoidable authority-reuse risk.
Authorization 162 is absent from active authorizations and appears exactly once as consumed, despite stale derived documents.
Both immutable baselines retain their expected blobs and counts; the successor contains one machine-specific root prefix.
Canonical correction and real-state validation are proportionate; portability must be added without modifying the existing baseline.
A separate corrective cycle is not technically necessary when Stage 2 is gated on a verified published Stage 1.
The documented sequence shows repeated corrective cycles without operational activation and a repeated encoding regression.

reasoning_summary: The audit correctly identifies real canonical-document, lifecycle-validation and portability defects while preserving the substantive 420-case semantic replay PASS. Its factual core is accepted only where independently reproduced from source files and Git blobs; claims that overstate invalidation or require another independent authorization are reversed.
